title: External inventory allocation release request
description: Self-release of a finished-goods hold by the external sales platform, for example when an order is cancelled before the warehouse confirms it. The body names the source only: the provider releases the RESERVED lines that this same service principal created for that source, never a quantity and never a lot.
$comment: OD-M3-REPLY-01 section 3.2 (owner decision 2B, 2026-10-08). Narrow exception next to OWNER-DIRECTIVE-2026-09-05-EXT-ALLOC-RESERVE: it reuses INVENTORY_ALLOCATION_CREATE and the allocation audience, so the admin permission INVENTORY_ALLOCATION_RELEASE is NOT granted to a service principal. Release only moves RESERVED to RELEASED through the same mechanism as warehouse release and hold expiry: no ledger entry, no goods movement. The pair (source_object_type, source_object_id) is exactly what the consumer sent to POST /v1/inventory/allocations.

source_object_type.description: Exactly the kind sent when the stock was reserved. SHIPMENT_REFERENCE is an internal allocation source and is rejected on this route.

source_object_id.description: Exactly the consumer-owned UUID sent when the stock was reserved. It is the only key of this command: a source held by another principal is indistinguishable from an unknown source and returns 404.
